locator.text: Display 35.6, p. 35, in the statement of Lemma 4.8

evidence: paper: E_{\mathrm{o}} = c_{\mathrm{patch}} f(\eta) X^{-1/2-\lambda} \quad \text{on } \mathcal{I}_1, \mathcal{I}_3, \mathcal{I}_4, \qquad c_{\mathrm{patch}} > 0.

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Same exponent and same three intervals: Lean's `s ≠ .heat` is exactly I_1, I_3, I_4 (the heat slot is the paper's I_2, 'the heat compensation uses only I_2'), and −(1/2 + F.data.core.lam) is the paper's −1/2 − λ. The rewriting is one line: by `xAmplitude_shape`, xAmplitude F XR η = (xAmplitude F XR 0)·(1+η²)⁻¹, so setting c_patch := xAmplitude F XR 0 (> 0 by `xAmplitude_pos`) turns the Lean right-hand side into c_patch f(η) X^{−1/2−λ}. Two facts worth recording, neither a difference with the paper: Lean's c_patch does depend on X_R (xAmplitude contains exp((1/2+λ)(log X_R + holdStart))), which is consistent with the paper, that claims independence of X and η only; and the Lean statement is for every real η, not only |η| ≤ 1. `heated_fields` is stated for the heat-compensated field HeatedOutgoing.E; for the extended profile that Lemma 4.8 actually produces it transfers by `E_eq_physical` on η ∈ [−1,1].
